text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... My skin's just not going back
to normal at all~. What should I do~...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, in times like this... consult the strategist!
Time to call Mom!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Mom? Well, well, hello there.
Yeah, yeah, I'm doing great.
So listen, actually, about my skin—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Mm-hmm, I'm doing all my homework
and studying hard too~. And guess what, guess what? My skin is—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Alrighty~ Take care of yourself too, Mom.
Tell everyone I said hi. Bye now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what!?
I didn't even get to discuss the most important thing?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser seems to be struggling
in her search for an effective skincare routine—
